stem: Which sentence from the story shows that the narrator takes advantage of her situation at the store?

options.label: A
options.text: While Grandma took the hot rolls from the oven, I told her about the candy.

options.label: B
options.text: I would have a nickel and two pennies back.

options.label: C
options.text: The longer I gazed at the candy display, the more certain I became that I needed two pennies' worth as a reward for coming to the store alone.

options.label: D
options.text: I found Grandma's purse and put the quarter in my pocket.
